Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation for renewal — evidence & retention questions

Hi Diego,

As we work toward our contract renewal (term ends 2027-07-31), our InfoSec team needs the updated SOC 2 evidence package and confirmation of your log retention windows. Specifically:

- A current index of artifacts (control mappings, evidence exports) we can hand off to our auditors.
- How long audit/ingest logs are retained (S3 bucket policy + access/egress).
- Any changes to data retention or export processes since last year.
- A proposed timeline for bulk evidence handoff (our auditors prefer a single bulk transfer).

Can you share the index and a proposed 2-week ingestion window? Also flag anything that will require a contract clause change (retention extension, seat counts, or dedicated capacity).

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Park

FinCo Inc.

Hi Olivia — looping in to align on commercial implications. If FinCo expects additional sustained capacity during the audit window (e.g., dedicated capacity or higher concurrency for log exports), we should discuss a short-term uplift vs. a term amendment.

Quick options:
- Short-term burst (3–7 days): one-off invoice at usage rates — no contract change.
- Temporary dedicated capacity pool (30–90 days): reserved monthly rate, small amendment to committed throughput.
- Permanent upsell to a higher tier (annual commit): contract amendment + pricing change.

If you can indicate whether this is a one-off audit spike or you anticipate long-term capacity growth, I’ll prepare a cost comparison and draft amendment language for legal.

Marissa
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick technical notes from infra ops before we finalize the runbook:

- Retention windows: application logs: 90 days by default; audit/KV caches: 365 days; we can extend audit logs to 730 days behind a contract amendment. Policy file attached.
- Transfer method: we will produce a presigned manifest with checksums. For auditor convenience we offer two delivery modes: secure S3 presigned URLs or an encrypted archive (AES-256) staged on our secure transfer host.
- Access controls: we will expand temporary STS roles to FinCo's auditor principal for the 3-day window; all access is audited and we will provide access logs.

Attachment: log-retention-policy-2027.txt (includes bucket names, lifecycle rules)

If finite retention extension is needed, Marissa — we will need an explicit clause that indicates retention period, who bears storage costs, and any export/immu table constraints.

—Kim
Head of Infrastructure Operations
Redwood Inference
